dynastyDetails.description: Kaleb is a renowned champion of Christianity who helped expand the territory, trade network, and influence of the kingdom of Aksum.
dynastyDetails.name: Kaleb

dynastyDetails.description: Ezana is known for converting Aksum to link(RELIGION_CHRISTIANITY). As an link(TRAIT_EVANGELIST), all link(UNITTRAIT_INFANTRY) Units produced in a City where he is link(CONCEPT_GOVERNOR) are link(EFFECTUNIT_ADEPT) and follow Christianity, allowing them to link(CONCEPT_SPREAD_RELIGION).
dynastyDetails.name: Ezana

dynastyDetails.description: Gudit burned down her nation's churches and monuments as revenge for the church selling her into slavery. Though link(TRAIT_INFAMOUS), she can link(MISSION_INTIMIDATE) her detractors into becoming link(RELATIONSHIP_TERRIFIED_OF) her.
dynastyDetails.name: Gudit

dynastyDetails.description: Known in legend as the Queen of Sheba, Makeda is able to perform the unique link(MISSION_LEAD_DELEGATION) Mission, which leads to mutually beneficial outcomes with her neighbors.
dynastyDetails.name: Makeda

dynastyDetails.description: One of the earliest rulers of Aksum, Gadarat expanded his nation from a mere city state to a mighty empire. A link(UNIT_WORKER) is granted for each Tribal Site cleared.
dynastyDetails.name: Gadarat

dynastyDetails.description: Ptolemy I Soter heads the science-oriented Ptolemaic dynasty. Ptolemy can recruit Court Scholars and build the Shrine of Serapis.
dynastyDetails.name: Ptolemy

dynastyDetails.description: Spartan King Leonidas is a uniquely powerful warrior who can greatly accelerate early expansion. He will however not live long and it will be up to his successors to secure their father's legacy.
dynastyDetails.name: Leonidas

dynastyDetails.description: The Athenian statesman Pericles is a very versatile leader, a patron of arts as skilled at nation-building as he is at warfare. Whether Pericles focuses on governance or battlefield leaderships, he will excel at the task.
dynastyDetails.name: Pericles

dynastyDetails.description: Young Alexander leads Greece shortly after his father's death. In addition to being a powerful warrior, Alexander is helped by people like the great philosopher Aristotle and others that will join the court. Alexander's mother, the scheming Queen Olympias, is uniquely capable politically and can link(MISSION_INFLUENCE_OLYMPIAS) other Characters on the Leader's behalf.
dynastyDetails.name: Alexander
